title: Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Cashless medical scheme for eligible ex-servicemen pensioners and their dependants through ECHS polyclinics and empanelled hospitals.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligible ex-servicemen pensioners and eligible dependants covered under ECHS rules, subject to membership/contribution and service-status conditions.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS).

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
